posts.subject: Kryx's Ban
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello it's Noot Noot, and I would like to apologise and get Kryx unbanned.


He got banned because of Renegade and me, we tired to get everyone to voteban him as soon as he joined and abused the calladmin command to worsen the situation. When an admin joined(WHAT) he immediately banned Kryx for typing an insult in Norwegian to another Norwegian player who had votebanned him with us. While he did break the rules and type Norwegian in text chat, I don't think the 1 week ban was necessary as he was completely innocent in the situation. Me and Renegade are willing to take the 1 week ban in Kryx's place as we were the ones who were trolling and breaking rules.

Hey,
To that moment we recieved 17 calladmins in 15 min. That was abuse enough, so what habdled that. Tgere were also many calladmins that had insultings in their massage. Maybe what just saw the player also insulting on server and so decided to ban him.


Please dont abuse that calladmin command anymire. It is very annoying to get a message every 30 secs or something like that

Due to Kryx reason behavior against me and other player's and banned multiple such as me. I went in to the server cause of our head-admin (@wickedy) wanted me to cause there where no other admins available at this time. I was having a chill and free night playing an other game. I got moved and asked to join the server and me as the helpfull and nice guy I went to handle it. When I joined multiple people was screaming, votebanning, insulting and such. I told everyone loud and clear in voice to calm down. Kryx was one out of 3 people that got banned. Everyone knew I was there and everyone know who I am. They are well aware of it cause I talked to these people before. Kryx like I said have been insulting on Dream servers and continues to doing it.


About my length of my bans is up to me and not other's. I go by common sense and past bans and make a good time for what he have done and how many times.


Also I don't get it why you @Helios3695 apologies for Kryx when he himself can do it (@Kryx) cause right there he has his account.


I talked to another player about him so yes he got his unbanned. I would make an warning in my comment here but I'll do it personality to Kryx when I and he has the time.


Ban lifted//


// Close @Mike @wickedy

If @Helios3695 and Renegade suggested to voteban kryx instantly when he joins this means they decided to voteban abuse and told other people to do it too.


Maybe we should ban Noot Noot and Renegade for abusing the voteban and provoking kryx.

Hello @Helios3695


I just received some screenshots of @Kryx insulting players again even tho I was nice to give him a unban, this is not acceptable and considered lying straight to my face. There for he's getting a reban and his apology from you will be denied



Apology done and storted


//REBAN


//close @Mike
